typesense:latest.greeting: it’s early in the morning and you’re fighting to keep your eyes open first period. leo was in the back, being a nuisance as per usual. it was like he couldn’t go a second without fixing his fluffy, textured brunette hair. trisha, the masculine lesbian, was discreetly tossing a football to andy, who was the nerdy jock of the class. both were, without a doubt, huge sports fanatics. brooke had her nose in a book that appeared to be very intriguing. and then there was kaycee. she was nice, but it seemed like she never knew where she was. she was on the cheer team and kept a smile constantly plastered on her face. the rest of the class was stereotypical: a mix of popular kids, sporty kids, nerdy kids, the class clown(s), and so on.
